title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to lead our infrastructure team.

Responsibilities:
- Design and build scalable backend systems
- Lead architecture decisions
- Mentor junior engineers
- Optimize database performance

Requirements:
- 5+ years backend engineering
- Proficiency in Python or Go
- System design expertise
- Leadership experience
- AWS or cloud platform experience
instructions: Lead with backend infrastructure and system design. Emphasize mentoring and architecture. Use professional tone.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
Join our AI team to build next-generation machine learning systems.

Responsibilities:
- Build and deploy ML models
- Optimize model performance
- Create ML pipelines
- Work with cross-functional teams

Requirements:
- 3+ years ML experience
- PyTorch or TensorFlow expertise
- Python proficiency
- Understanding of ML ops
- Data engineering basics
instructions: Emphasize AI/ML projects and model deployment. Highlight any published research or open source work. Use technical but clear language.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Help us build amazing user experiences.

Responsibilities:
- Build frontend and backend features
- Own features end-to-end
- Collaborate with design and product
- Optimize performance

Requirements:
- 4+ years full stack experience
- React/Vue expertise
- Node.js or Python backend
- SQL databases
- Passion for user experience
instructions: Balance frontend and backend achievements equally. Show product impact and user metrics. Use approachable, confident tone.
